classification.description: Doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors (aluminium)

origin_result.basis: Missing a bill of materials (including each input's description, 6-digit HS code, origin country, value, and currency) and a manufacturer declaration (product price, FOB or Ex-Works basis, final manufacture in the UAE, and specific operations performed in the UAE).

procedure.step: The factory must be registered through the Ministry of Economy and Tourism's Factory Registration service prior to applying for a certificate of origin.
procedure.authority: the Ministry of Economy and Tourism

procedure.step: The Ministry of Foreign Trade processes applications submitted electronically through the Certificate of Origin for India e-service portal, requiring proof of factory registration, commercial invoice, and purchase invoice if trading.
The competent authority issues the certificate of origin prior to, at, or within five working days of exportation.
The Ministry of Foreign Trade charges a certificate fee ranging from AED 10 to AED 200 based on the shipment value.
The exporter must maintain origin records and cost breakdowns for at least five years starting from the end of the calendar year of certificate issue.
The Indian importer claims preferential duty rates upon filing the bill of entry and must retain origin documentation under CAROTAR 2020 rules for at least five years.

caveats.note: No official page read names the Ministry of Foreign Trade as the issuer of the India CEPA certificate specifically: its service page covers preferential certificates in general, and the India-specific page is still on moet.gov.ae.
CEPA rates reduce Basic Customs Duty (BCD) only. IGST, GST compensation cess, SWS and any anti-dumping or safeguard duty still apply.
'+' in a rule is read as 'and' (both tests must pass). The agreement does not define '+', so this is Mansha's interpretation.

A producer in a free zone is likely not eligible for Factory Registration, because it requires a factory outside a free zone, and registration is needed before applying for the certificate of origin for India. Confirm with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism.
